title: Keeps the Rug in Place
text: Keeps the Rug in Place. My husband installed engineered bamboo flooring in our bedroom recently. I have a plush rug on the floor by my side of the bed. I had one of those rug gripping pieces that you cut to the size of the rug and put underneath it, but it really wasn't doing a good job of keeping the rug in place. This really does work! I only put a piece in each corner. It's been a few days and I have been impressed with how the rug doesn't move. I pulled up part of one corner of the rug to see if it was damaging the floor and there is no evidence of that at this time.
